title: Fact Grounded Attention: Eliminating Hallucination in Large Language Models Through Attention Level Knowledge Integration
abstract: arXiv:2509.25252v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: "The greatest enemy of knowledge is not ignorance, it is the illusion of knowledge." Large Language Models have conquered natural language but remain prisoners of their own probabilistic nature--confidently hallucinating facts they never truly knew. We present Fact Grounded Attention (FGA), a novel architectural modification that transforms unreliable language models into deterministic truth tellers by injecting verifiable knowledge directly into the attention mechanism. Unlike existing approaches that patch hallucinations after generation or prepend retrieved text, FGA intervenes at the mathematical heart of the transformer--the pre-softmax attention scores--creating a model that cannot hallucinate when facts exist in its knowledge base. Our experiments across 1,107 technical queries spanning smartphones, laptops, and electric vehicles demonstrate a transformation from 6.3% accuracy in vanilla Llama 3.2 to 99.7% accuracy with FGA. M

translated_title: 事实接地注意力：通过注意力层面的知识整合消除大语言模型中的幻觉
translated_abstract: “知识最大的敌人不是无知，而是知识的错觉。”大语言模型虽然已经征服了自然语言，但仍然受制于其概率本质——它们会自信地幻觉出自己从未真正知晓的事实。我们提出了事实接地注意力（FGA），这是一种新颖的架构修改方法，通过将可验证的知识直接注入注意力机制，将不可靠的语言模型转变为确定性的真相陈述者。与现有方法在生成后修补幻觉或在输入前拼接检索文本不同，FGA直接在Transformer的数学核心——softmax之前的注意力分数——进行干预，从而创建了一个在知识库中存在相应事实时无法产生幻觉的模型。我们在涵盖智能手机、笔记本电脑和电动汽车的1,107个技术查询上进行的实验表明，原始Llama 3.2的准确率仅为6.3%，而使用FGA后准确率提升至99.7%。
tldr: 本文提出事实接地注意力（FGA），通过在Transformer的softmax前注意力分数中直接注入可验证知识，使Llama 3.2在1,107个技术查询上的准确率从6.3%跃升至99.7%，实现了知识库内事实的零幻觉。
en_tdlr: Fact Grounded Attention (FGA) intervenes at the pre-softmax attention scores to inject verifiable knowledge directly into the transformer, boosting Llama 3.2's accuracy from 6.3% to 99.7% across 1,107 technical queries and eliminating hallucination when facts exist in the knowledge base.
